sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; Rethinking Indirect Prompt Injection ranked top and known September 7 duplicates were excluded.
Read arXiv abs, official cs/new listing, HTML full text, and TeX source; extracted harness design, ASR/JSR metrics, task-suite sizes, ablations, risk boundary, and limitations.
Kept original arXiv submission time separate from official current-list evidence and treated the results as controlled synthetic-environment evidence, not production exploit rates.
Markdown is text-first with TLDR, tables, formulas, pseudocode, Mermaid, figure/table interpretation, and no directly reusable attack payload instructions.
